_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The coil base rate (3% of 12h windows see ±2+ moves) makes HOLD the statistically honest call, and neither brain has identified a confirmed breaker — the analyst explicitly states their 17% direction accuracy means they miss breakers, and the narrative's accumulation thesis lacks the institutional flow confirmation required to call UP.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst calls HOLD with downward skew citing absent institutional bid; narrative implies a bottoming process with accumulation framing. The split is fundamental: distribution vs accumulation read of the same conditions.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows sustain >30 for 48h AND stablecoin growth turns positive >50 — this would validate the narrative's accumulation thesis and shift phase up to Anxiety
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC breaks below $59k with VIX >22 and funding turns negative — this would confirm the analyst's downward skew and force a deeper Panic flush toward Capitulation
